runtime.note: A single native binary. The host needs no .NET runtime.

commands.name: systemctl
commands.why: resolves the systemd kind of a watched server

commands.name: kgsm
commands.why: lists instances so per-server metrics have a watch-list (Monitor__KgsmPath)
commands.without: host metrics are served in full; the servers array stays empty

commands.name: docker
commands.without: container servers are not sampled; native and systemd ones are

commands.name: bpftool
commands.why: loads and attaches the eBPF per-server network meter
commands.without: rxBps/txBps report null — 'not measured', never a fabricated 0

commands.name: clang
commands.why: compiles net_meter.bpf.c when no prebuilt object is installed
commands.without: nothing, provided net_meter.bpf.o ships beside the binary — which is the packaged case

services.name: kgsm-watchdog.service
services.why: owns kgsm.slice, the cgroup the network meter attaches to and where native servers live
services.without: native per-server metrics are unavailable; host metrics are unaffected

system.why: per-server cpu/memory/io are read from cgroup v2 files
every host metric is read from /proc and /sys
the network meter pins its map at /sys/fs/bpf/kgsm/net_metrics
the typed BPF map needs BTF to load
granted to the daemon as AmbientCapabilities=CAP_BPF so it can read the pinned map
system.warning: NoNewPrivileges=true makes a setcap'd FILE capability ignored, and a package upgrade drops file capabilities anyway. The unit's AmbientCapabilities is the only grant that works.

units.note: kgsm-net-meter.service and its setup script stay ROOT-owned: the script loads and attaches BPF as root, and a root-executed file an unprivileged user can rewrite is an escalation path. It is installed by setup.sh, never by deploy.sh, and is deliberately absent from UNITS=.
